state.incident: INC-20871 checkout latency and duplicate payments
state.customer_impact: slow checkout for 31 minutes; 212 orders captured twice
log: 02:14 [pager] Alert fired: checkout-api p99 latency above 2.5 s for 5 minutes in eu-west-1.
02:16 [on-call] Acknowledged. Dashboards show the latency rise started at 02:07, right after the 02:05 deploy of checkout-api build 4812.
02:19 [on-call] Error rate is 0.8 % (normal is 0.1 %). Most errors are timeouts calling the payments service. Payments itself reports healthy.
02:23 [on-call] Connection pool on checkout-api is saturated: 200 of 200 connections in use, queue length growing. Build 4812 changed the pool size from 400 to 200 by mistake in the config map.
02:26 [on-call] Rolled back the config map to the previous revision. Pods are restarting one by one; three of twelve are on the old pool size so far.
02:31 [pager] Second alert: order-confirmation emails delayed, queue depth 18,000 and rising.
02:33 [on-call] Email delay is downstream of checkout: confirmations are only sent after payment capture, and captures are retrying. Not a separate fault.
02:38 [on-call] All twelve pods restarted. Pool usage dropped to 140 of 400. p99 latency back to 410 ms. Error rate 0.15 %.
02:41 [support] Customer support reports 37 tickets from users who were charged but saw an error page. Some of them retried and may have paid twice.
02:47 [on-call] Checked payments ledger: 212 orders have two successful captures within ten minutes between 02:07 and 02:38. Refunds are not automatic for this case.
02:52 [on-call] Email queue draining at about 1,500 per minute; expected to be empty around 03:05.
02:58 [finance] Finance asks for the list of duplicate captures before the morning settlement batch at 06:00, otherwise the duplicates settle and refunds take five to seven days.
03:04 [on-call] Exported the 212 orders to the incident document. Did not issue refunds yet: refund tooling needs approval from a payments engineer for batches over 50.

03:09 [on-call] Email queue empty. Latency and error rate normal for 30 minutes. Root cause: config change in build 4812 halved the connection pool. A guard rail to block pool sizes below 300 is proposed but not merged.
03:12 [on-call] Open items: approve and run the refund batch before 06:00, merge the guard rail, write the post-incident review, reply to the 37 support tickets.
